title: Linear Variance of the Random 3-SAT Hitting Time
summary: For random 3-SAT on n Boolean variables, with independent uniformly signed clauses on three distinct variables sampled with replacement, we prove that the first unsatisfiable prefix has variance $`\Theta(n)`$. The upper bound removes the logarithmic loss in the earlier variance estimate; the matching lower bound follows from Wilson's transition-width theorem.
family_title: Limiting random SAT thresholds, sharp variance and computability

review.reason: Proves variance bounds for the first unsatisfiable prefix in random 3-SAT.
